Subject: Vendor master: Legal entity anchoring & PO ingress plan

Sara —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re ready to start the vendor-master setup for Aurelia Dynamics so AP can accept POs and process invoices cleanly. To avoid delays downstream, can you confirm the following and return the attached master-info form? Quick checklist below — anything missing, flag it and we’ll adjust.

Required for initial master creation (please reply inline):
- Legal entity name (exactly as on tax docs)
- Legal form (LLC / Corp / etc.) and jurisdiction of formation
- Tax ID / VAT number (if applicable)
- Registered address (street, city, state/province, country, postal code)
- Remittance email + contact name (who receives payment confirmations)
- Billing contact and phone number (for invoice reconciliation)
- Preferred PO routing (ERP code if you have one)
- Billing/cert documents: W-9 or W-8, Certificate of Incorporation (attach if easy)

Attached: Aurelia_Master_Info_Form.pdf (fill and return)
Next steps after we receive everything:
1) Procurement validates docs and creates master record (internal SLA: 2 business days)
2) AP issues vendor ID and confirms PO routing details to your remittance contact
3) We’ll send a sample PO and request a sample invoice for validation

Marissa and Kimberly are looped for procurement/AP verifications — copying them so they see any early gaps. If anything here should go to someone else on your side, point me to the correct contact.

Thanks — appreciate quick turnaround so we can include Aurelia in the next PO run.

—
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference

Sara —

Appreciate the fast response and the attachments — that’s very helpful. Quick follow-ups:

- W-9: Please provide when available; if you can upload to the Drive link I shared we’ll attach to the vendor record.
- Billing signer: we need an authorized signer for vendor agreements (name & title). If Lina is authorized, please confirm her title and attach a short letter of authorization or a board resolution if available.
- Bank details: AP will validate the remittance sheet; if you prefer ACH, we’ll need the bank routing and account confirmation steps (our process includes a micro-deposit verification).

Ben — looping you for vendor creation and to confirm SLA for vendor ID issuance and PO ingress mapping. Marissa/Kim — feel free to flag any documentation gaps we should raise with Sara.

If everything looks ok, our timeline is: create master record by end of week, vendor ID and sample PO early next week, then a quick invoice validation.

Thanks — Naomi
